recipes.name: Calming Lotus Tea
recipes.description: Crisp floral base sweetened with wild honey, gently soothing troubled minds and releasing fatigue.

recipes.name: Glacial Berry Iced Tea
recipes.description: Succulent sweet-tart forest berries blended with cooling frost crystals for an exhilarating refresher.
recipes.effect_description: Invigorating chill, increases walking speed by 15% for 3 minutes

recipes.name: Thousand Stars Lavender Tea
recipes.description: Delicate lavender blossoms infused with shimmering stardust powder, guiding the soul into serene stillness.
recipes.effect_description: Exhales faint stardust, induces sound sleep and recovers 100% Stamina

recipes.name: Solar Dawn Infusion
recipes.description: Golden-amber tea shimmering like early sunlight, pouring fiery vitality into miners before deep descents.
recipes.effect_description: Increases mining pickaxe speed by 25% for 3 real minutes, restores 50 Stamina

recipes.name: Honey Chamomile Brioche
recipes.description: Fluffy, tender loaf rich with creamy butter and sweet forest wildflower honey notes.

recipes.name: Bioluminescent Berry Scone
recipes.description: Golden-baked crumbly scone studded with glowing, sweet-tart snowberries.
recipes.effect_description: Restores vitality and uplifts daily mood

recipes.name: Forest Spirit Cinnamon Roll
recipes.description: Spiced pastry swirl filled with warming forest cinnamon sugar — the all-time favorite of blacksmith Boris.
recipes.effect_description: Infuses the body with deep hearth warmth, repelling cold chills

recipes.name: Starlight Crystal Tart
recipes.description: Exquisite artisanal tart with shimmering violet amethyst jelly, resembling a starry midnight sky.
recipes.effect_description: Radiates a mystical aura, increasing rare ore drop chances in mines

recipes.name: Faerie Birthday Cake
recipes.description: Celebratory jubilee confection adorned with twinkling firefly lights and fresh frost berries.
recipes.effect_description: Brings boundless joy and unlocks special cherished dialogue when gifted on birthdays

recipes.name: Moonlight Dew Tea
recipes.description: Lotus tea leaves brewed with moonstone essence and celestial stardust powder, bringing deep solace beneath nocturnal skies.
recipes.effect_description: Pacifies sorrow, grants +30% nighttime stamina regeneration and unlocks hidden confessions

recipes.name: Deepwood Emerald Tart
recipes.description: A crisp golden tart filled with emerald woodland nectar and wildflower honey, brimming with primal herb vitality.
recipes.effect_description: Grants +40 Max Stamina for 5 minutes and doubles natural health recovery speed

recipes.name: Diamond Purified Tea
recipes.description: Lotus and lavender tea filtered through a glacial diamond prism, radiating celestial light that dispels curses and toxins.
recipes.effect_description: Cleanses all debuffs and grants complete immunity to abyssal shadow damage for 4 minutes
